message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) affected | Long‑Weekend? |
|------|---------|----------------------|---------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Yes – Monday |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Yes – Friday |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday (all provinces) | Yes – Friday |
| **Apr 23** | St. George’s Day (Prince Edward Island) | Yes – Friday |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Yes – Monday |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | Yes – Monday |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Yes – Monday |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Yes – Monday |

### Notes

* **Family Day** is observed on the third Monday in February in most provinces, but the exact date varies by province.  
* **St. Patrick’s Day** is a statutory holiday only in Newfoundland & Labrador.  
* **St. George’s Day** is a statutory holiday only in Prince Edward Island.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays that may create long weekends (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador, **St. George’s Day** in PEI).  
* If you need a complete, up‑to‑date list for all provinces, you can query the public holiday API at <https://date.nager.at/Api/v2/PublicHolidays/2023/CA> (or use a similar service).  

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app!
